root_cause.contamination_stage: TEST-EXECUTION (inside the trigger test function's own body, not collection/fixture-setup/teardown)
root_cause.description: The node deletes every sys.modules entry matching `pcae.authority_evaluation*` OR any of _FORBIDDEN_IMPORT_ROOTS (line 732-742), which includes the literal string "pcae.core" -- so it also deletes `pcae.core.hpac_foundation`, `pcae.core.human_principal_registry`, and every other already-imported `pcae.core.*` submodule from sys.modules, then calls importlib.import_module('pcae.authority_evaluation'). This does not remove references other already-imported code (fixtures, registries, other test modules holding `from pcae.core.hpac_foundation import HPACStoreAuthority` at module scope) still hold to the OLD class objects. When the victim test file subsequently triggers a fresh import of `pcae.core.hpac_foundation` / `pcae.core.human_principal_registry`, Python constructs NEW module and class objects with identical __module__/__qualname__ but a distinct id() -- the exact signature the tracer observed. `isinstance(record, HPACStoreAuthority)`-style checks in the victim then compare live objects against whichever class reference happens to be bound where the check executes, producing the 37 failures + 2 victim ERRORs (test_94_counter_missing_fails_closed_not_zero, test_95_assurance_class_of_enrolled_records_is_production).
